description: List every district championship event a district has held, across all seasons, each paired with the awards given there. Returns full event records (including championship divisions) plus award records (name, type, recipient team keys and awardees). Use for district championship winners, Impact/Engineering Inspiration history, and long-run district retrospectives. Large for long-running districts (about 300 KB for 'fim').

district_abbreviation.description: FRC district abbreviation without a year (e.g., 'fim' for FIRST in Michigan, 'ne' for New England, 'chs' for Chesapeake, 'pnw' for Pacific Northwest, 'fit' for FIRST In Texas). Covers every season of the district, including renames such as 'mar' to 'fma'. Use get_districts to discover abbreviations.
